content.short: Echo provides cutting-edge infrastructure for liquid staking platforms, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Bitcoin liquid staking and restaking on Move-based chains. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Echo redefines how users interact with liquid staking platforms. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Aptos and Solana to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Echo stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
